target_customer: Architects, contractors and MEP consultants in India
problem: Mechanical, electrical, fire and plumbing design for buildings is done manually by consultants, slow and costly.
business_model: Software that automates MEP design and bill of materials, with a consultancy service component per a directory

founders.name: Naman Kasliwal
education: IIT Bombay, bachelor's and master's in Electrical Engineering and Operations Research
founders.background_notes: YC page cites projects for the Indian Army, Mumbai Railways and the Bihar government; these are clients, not employers.

competitors.name: MSUITE
competitors.traction_then: Iowa startup in MEP construction software
competitors.funding_then: $4M seed announced Aug 2020 (about five months after the batch)

competitors.name: eVolve MEP
competitors.traction_then: Announced partnership with Autodesk and GTP Services in July 2020 (about four months after the batch)

technical_complexity.rationale: Auto-routing of building services under code constraints and costing is hard optimization work, though the founder had operations research training.

defensibility.rationale: Output depends on design rules that Autodesk and others could add into Revit; services work reduced software leverage.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Autodesk added systems analysis for MEP in Revit 2020.1 in August 2019; no direct acquisition of PillarPlus found.

market_need_then: MEP design was manual and done by consultants per the YC page; Autodesk Revit 2020.1 MEP features in Aug 2019 show tooling demand.

brand_strength.rationale: A search for brand material returned only directory pages and unrelated companies named Pillar.

outcome_analysis: PillarPlus, a roughly 30 person Indian team, automated MEP design for buildings and went through YC W20. The directory lists it Inactive and the founder now builds kaptured.ai, but no shutdown notice or post-mortem was found, so the cause is not public. One directory also describes it as an MEP consultancy, which suggests a services-heavy model.
notes: pillarplus.com did not resolve from this session. Seed 150K March 2020 rests on CB Insights; Seedtable lists a similar 150K seed dated Aug 2019 under the name Pillar, unconfirmed as the same company. MSUITE and eVolve sources post-date the batch by 4 to 5 months, noted in the entries; competitor traction beyond those items was not found. Autodesk Revit 2020.1 MEP features cited from an Architosh article dated 2019-08 seen in search results only.
